notes: Finished exercises lock in your workout so you can't log into them by accident. Tap ✎ Edit to reopen one.
Fix past workouts: open any workout and tap a set to change it, or add a set you forgot.
Watch stats: time now has separate hours, minutes and seconds boxes, and works with any smartwatch or fitness app.
Reinstalling? Restore a backup right from the welcome screen.
Cleaner Home: your goals are now one compact tile (tap it for the full breakdown), no matter how many you pick.
Today shows your progress (1 of 3 done), which of your goals the next workout hits, and a protein bar.
Reminders (weigh-in, backup, setup) shrank to one line each. Insights show the top 3, with the rest a tap away, plus a nudge when a goal has no work yet this week.
